title: New Ru(III) 2,6-Bis(2-Benzimidazolyl)Pyridine Complexes Bearing P-Sub-Benzyl Thiosemicarbazones Schiff Base: Synthesis, Characterization, DNA Binding and Anti-cancer Activity.
authors: Singh, Ashok K; Singh, Ravindra K; Pandav, Kumud; Bano, Swaila; Arshi, Farha; Kumar, Amarendra; Kumar Singh, Sudheer; Chandra, Ramesh
one_liner_zh: 该文研究钌配合物的合成、表征及其与DNA的插入结合和抗癌活性，虽涉及DNA结合但非蛋白质-DNA互作，且方法以实验为主，仅含DFT和对接，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模关联甚微。
abstract: The six mononuclear Schiff's base Ru(III) complexes viz., [Ru(BZP)(LA)(2)].2NO(3) (MRA), [Ru(BZP)(LB)(2)].2NO(3) (MRB), [Ru(BZP))(LC)(2)].2NO(3) (MRC), [Ru(BZP))(LD)(2)].2NO(3) (MRD), [Ru(BZP)(LE)(2)].2NO(3) (MRE) and [Ru(BZP)(LF)(2)].2NO(3) (MRF), were synthesized using of (BZP=2,6-bis(2-benzimidazolyl)pyridine and p-sub-benzylthiosemicarbazones (BTS) [(Sub=4-NO(2) (LA), 4-N(CH(3))(2) (LB), 4-Cl (LC), 4-OCH(3) (LD), 4-OCH(2)Ph (LE), and 4-OH (LF)] as an ancillary ligands. The thiosemicarbazones ligands (LA-LF) were obtained by the condensation of p-substituted benzaldehyde and thiosemicarbazide. These complexes were characterized by elemental analysis, IR, ESR, ESI-MS, electronic absorption spectroscopy. The geometry was optimized by theoretical calculation using DFT and structure reveals that MRA-MRF adopt octahedral geometry. Further, the complexes were examined for anti-cancer against Leukemia cancer cell line K562 and shown significant responses to these cells. Moreover, DNA binding studies were conducted with all complexes MRA-MRF and the binding constant (K(b)) were found i.e., 1.10x10(4), 1.54x10(4), 2.87x10(4), 1.67x10(4), 1.98x10(4) and 1.59x10(4), respectively. It was found that DNA binds in intercalation mode which is also validated by the docking studies.
abstract_zh: 合成了六种单核席夫碱Ru(III)配合物，即[Ru(BZP)(LA)(2)].2NO(3) (MRA)、[Ru(BZP)(LB)(2)].2NO(3) (MRB)、[Ru(BZP))(LC)(2)].2NO(3) (MRC)、[Ru(BZP))(LD)(2)].2NO(3) (MRD)、[Ru(BZP)(LE)(2)].2NO(3) (MRE)和[Ru(BZP)(LF)(2)].2NO(3) (MRF)，使用(BZP=2,6-双(2-苯并咪唑基)吡啶和对位取代苄基硫代半卡巴腙 (BTS) [(取代基=4-NO(2) (LA), 4-N(CH(3))(2) (LB), 4-Cl (LC), 4-OCH(3) (LD), 4-OCH(2)Ph (LE), 和4-OH (LF)]作为辅助配体。硫代半卡巴腙配体（LA-LF）通过对位取代苯甲醛与硫代半卡巴肼的缩合反应获得。这些配合物通过元素分析、IR、ESR、ESI-MS、电子吸收光谱进行了表征。通过DFT理论计算优化了几何结构，结果表明MRA-MRF采用八面体几何构型。此外，这些配合物对白血病癌细胞系K562进行了抗癌活性测试，并显示出对这些细胞的显著响应。进一步地，对所有配合物MRA-MRF进行了DNA结合研究，测得的结合常数(K(b))分别为1.10x10(4)、1.54x10(4)、2.87x10(4)、1.67x10(4)、1.98x10(4)和1.59x10(4)。发现DNA以嵌入模式结合，这也通过对接研究得到了验证。
